Up to four players take the roles of rats, sharing steering, repairs and grapple duties on a scrap-built steamboat to cross dangerous swamps. Proximity voice chat is supported.

entries.headline: The Witcher 3 remaster reports PC save errors and a temporary workaround
entries.summary: AUTOMATON reports save-error messages, problems reading old saves and settings not persisting in the PC remaster. CD PROJEKT RED’s Japan representative acknowledges the issue and suggests double-byte characters in save paths may be involved. The temporary advice is to use a Documents path without those characters or wait for a fix; the report does not establish that every user is affected.

entries.headline: Xbox Insiders test Mythic Achievements for completing original achievements
entries.summary: Xbox Wire announces an Insider preview of Mythic Achievements. Completing all original achievements earns the status; achievements added through DLC or updates are not required, and earned status is retained. Eligible past completions, including Xbox 360 games, are recognised retroactively. A new Gaming profile tab displays achievements, Gamerscore milestones and completed games.
